case_title: State of Madhya Pradesh v. Pradeep Sharma
evidence_type: Confessional statements, witness statements, medical report
confession: Confessional statements of co-accused relied on
aggravating_circumstances: Accused were absconders, did not cooperate with investigation
neutral_facts: The accused, along with others, conspired to poison the victim, who later died from poisoning. The victim consumed poisoned milk rabri at a tea house. After consuming the substance, the victim's condition deteriorated, leading to his death. The body was sent for post-mortem, which confirmed poisoning. A charge sheet was filed against several accused, including the respondent. The accused were declared absconders and a proclamation was issued under Section 82 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. The High Court granted anticipatory bail to the accused, which was challenged and ultimately set aside.
